$comment: Hand-maintained award triggers for league tasks, by league type and task id (the ids in the generated league-tasks.json), merged over the triggers the generator derived (this file wins). For a task the generator's name rules cannot map: a kill of an NPC the Wiki names differently, a quest whose task is not called "Complete <quest>". The kinds LeagueTasks understands are in docs/leagues.md (Tasks): kill { npcs: [names], count } (the kills of all of them added up), level { skill, level }, any-level { level, excluding }, level-up, total-level { level }, base-level { level }, combat-level { level }, quest { name }. Other plugins can also complete a task directly with the `league:complete-task` event.
